from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485762/attempts/600043634274485a8fca1406353e4b51/system/state/workspace/programs/task-95d3669d.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Horizontal bars are completed across internal gaps; marker columns
    # carry each bar's color vertically toward the next bar.
    bars = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colors = [v for v in row if v]
        if colors:
            bars.append((r, colors))
            # Complete each color's interval between its first and last cell.
            for color in set(colors):
                cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
                if len(cols) > 1:
                    for c in range(min(cols), max(cols) + 1):
                        out[r][c] = color
    markers = [c for c in range(w) if grid[-1][c] != 0]
    # For each marker, extend the colors of horizontal bars upward and
    # downward through the rows between consecutive bars.
    for c in markers:
        for i, (r, colors) in enumerate(bars):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0:
                # In demos, each marker falls into the horizontal bar's
                # domain; use the color nearest to this column if needed.
                color = min((cc for cc in range(w) if grid[r][cc]), key=lambda cc: abs(cc-c))
                color = grid[r][color]
            start = 0 if i == 0 else bars[i-1][0] + 1
            end = r
            for rr in range(start, end + 1):
                out[rr][c] = color
    return out
'''
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); path.write_text(code)
print(path)
